row.evidence: WalkMe's help centre documents "a SCIM 2.0 compliant endpoint" for managing users and groups, while the pricing page offers only "Request a quote".
row.notes: Quote-only: WalkMe (an SAP company) publishes no plans or prices, so SCIM can only be bought through sales. The SCIM 2.0 API is documented in full (Users, Groups, ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas; filter and pagination up to 1000; Basic or bearer auth; separate base URLs for US, EU, Canada, FedRAMP and SAP-hosted tenants). Okta has a WalkMe OIN app with Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push; other IdPs can use the generic endpoint. No plan gate within the product is documented.

plans.name: WalkMe Digital Adoption Platform
plans.notes: No public tiers or prices; the pricing page offers only 'Request a quote' / 'Get a quote'.

auth.token_source: WalkMe Admin Center > Security & Audit > SCIM Integration > + Create SCIM Integration (Basic or Bearer credentials)
auth.notes: Basic auth (generated username/password) or a bearer token; the Okta app uses Basic credentials in the API Token field.

deprovision.notes: DELETE /Users/{id} deletes the user and removes it from all groups; Okta's 'Deactivate users' feature is supported, but what deactivation does inside WalkMe (seat, sessions, content) is not documented.

filtering.notes: Operators eq, ne, co, sw, ew, gt, ge, lt, le, pr; filterable attributes are not listed.

custom.how: SAP extension schema urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:sap:2.0:User (userUuid, auto-generated if absent)

attributes.notes: The enterprise extension schema is listed as supported but its attributes are not enumerated.

roles.how: Okta groups can be pushed or linked to WalkMe groups; no SCIM role attribute is documented.

rate_limits.text: Rate limited (429 Too Many Requests); limits not published

limitations.text: Sorting is not supported; sortBy and sortOrder are ignored.
The SCIM password is shown only once; a lost password means deleting and recreating the integration.

auth.notes: Short-lived JWTs (24 h) from accounts/connect/token, or Personal Access Tokens valid for one year.

endpoints.purpose: Get a single user by user ID
Get a single user by email

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, OIDC, SCIM and Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push as checked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: WalkMe links a Microsoft tutorial for Azure AD SSO; learn.microsoft.com walkme-tutorial and walkme-provisioning-tutorial URLs returned 404, so the gallery listing could not be confirmed.

Enterprise-extension attributes accepted are not enumerated.
SCIM token expiry and rate-limit values are not published.
Whether SAML sign-in creates users just-in-time is not stated.
